audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for famine journey, Joseph's recognition, spy accusation, three-day custody, Simeon, money in sacks, and Jacob's refusal over Benjamin.

verses.restored: Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt and said to his sons, Why do you look at one another?

familiar.text: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

verses.restored: He said, Look, I have heard there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy for us, so that we may live and not die.

familiar.text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

verses.restored: Ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

familiar.text: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

verses.restored: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob did not send with his brothers, for he said, Lest harm meet him.

familiar.text: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

verses.restored: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

familiar.text: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.restored: Joseph was the ruler over the land; he was the one selling to all the people of the earth. Joseph’s brothers came and bowed to him with faces to the ground.

familiar.text: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

verses.restored: Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he made himself a stranger to them and spoke harshly, saying, Where have you come from? They said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

familiar.text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

verses.restored: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.

familiar.text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

verses.restored: Joseph remembered the dreams he had dreamed about them and said, You are spies; you have come to see the nakedness of the land.

familiar.text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

verses.restored: They said to him, No, my lord; your servants have come to buy food.

familiar.text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

verses.restored: We are all sons of one man; we are honest. Your servants are not spies.

familiar.text: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

verses.restored: He said to them, No, you have come to see the nakedness of the land.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

verses.restored: They said, Your servants are twelve brothers, sons of one man in the land of Canaan. Look, the youngest is with our father today, and one is no more.

familiar.text: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

verses.restored: Joseph said to them, It is as I spoke to you: you are spies.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

verses.restored: By this you shall be tested: by the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here unless your youngest brother comes here.

familiar.text: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

verses.restored: Send one of you to get your brother, while you remain bound, so your words may be tested, whether truth is with you; if not, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you are spies.

familiar.text: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

verses.restored: He gathered them into custody three days.

familiar.text: And he put them all together into ward three days.

verses.restored: On the third day Joseph said to them, Do this and live, for I fear the Divine.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

verses.restored: If you are honest, let one of your brothers be bound in your prison house; you go and bring grain for the famine of your houses.

familiar.text: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

verses.restored: Bring your youngest brother to me, so your words will be verified and you will not die. And they did so.

familiar.text: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

verses.restored: They said to one another, Truly we are guilty concerning our brother, because we saw the distress of his soul when he pleaded with us, and we did not listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.

familiar.text: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

verses.restored: Reuben answered, Did I not tell you, Do not sin against the boy? But you did not listen. Now his blood is being required.

familiar.text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

verses.restored: They did not know that Joseph understood, for the interpreter was between them.

familiar.text: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

verses.restored: He turned away from them and wept. Then he returned and spoke to them, took Simeon from them, and bound him before their eyes.

familiar.text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

verses.restored: Joseph commanded that their vessels be filled with grain, that each man’s silver be returned to his sack, and that provisions be given for the way; and it was done for them.

familiar.text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

verses.restored: They loaded their grain on their donkeys and went from there.

familiar.text: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

verses.restored: One opened his sack to give his donkey feed at the lodging place, and he saw his silver, and look, it was in the mouth of his sack.

familiar.text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

verses.restored: He said to his brothers, My silver has been returned, and look, it is in my sack. Their hearts went out, and they trembled, saying, What is this the Divine has done to us?

familiar.text: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

verses.restored: They came to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan and told him all that had happened to them.

familiar.text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

verses.restored: The man, lord of the land, spoke harshly with us and treated us as spies of the land.

familiar.text: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

verses.restored: We said to him, We are honest; we are not spies.

familiar.text: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

verses.restored: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in Canaan.

familiar.text: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.restored: The man, lord of the land, said to us, By this I will know that you are honest: leave one brother with me, take grain for the famine of your houses, and go.

familiar.text: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

verses.restored: Bring your youngest brother to me; then I will know you are not spies but honest men. I will give your brother to you, and you may trade in the land.

familiar.text: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

verses.restored: As they emptied their sacks, look, each man’s bundle of silver was in his sack. When they and their father saw the bundles of silver, they were afraid.

familiar.text: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

verses.restored: Jacob their father said, You have bereaved me: Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and Benjamin you would take. All this is upon me.

familiar.text: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

verses.restored: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, You may put my two sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Put him in my hand, and I will return him to you.

familiar.text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

verses.restored: He said, My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead and he alone remains. If harm meets him on the way you go, you will bring down my gray hair in sorrow to Sheol.

familiar.text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
